cases: null device or error regulator returns -ENODEV
already-disabled regulator returns success without a second disable
enabled valid regulator calls regulator_disable and returns success
regulator_disable failure propagates the observed error and logs it
limitations: The host harness validates the helper with regulator stubs; it does not drive a real regulator on NX809J.
Electrical discharge timing, power-rail dependencies and concurrent power transitions remain separate runtime gates.
